article_insects.summary: Insects are small, but they are everywhere and they do enormous work. After reading this, you can spot an insect by its three body parts and six legs, learn what insects do for us, and watch them closely without hurting them.
article_insects.title: The Wonderful World of Insects

article_why_brush_teeth.summary: Brushing feels normal, but teeth are in real danger every single day. After reading this, you can explain what plaque does to a tooth, brush properly, and pick snacks that are kinder to your teeth.
article_why_brush_teeth.title: Why Do We Brush Our Teeth?
